source_summary: Manual motif plan based on the attached Summer 22 NPM Chinese landscape painting.

motifs.name: distant_mountain_ranges
motifs.description: soft blue-green mountain ranges in the far distance, partly veiled by mist

motifs.name: right_hillside_with_pines
motifs.description: large right hillside with layered slopes and dense pine clusters along the ridges

motifs.name: central_village_compound
motifs.description: central walled village compound with layered roofs, courtyards, trees, and pavilions

motifs.name: left_village_houses
motifs.description: left cluster of village houses and walls emerging among trees

motifs.name: tall_pines_above_village
motifs.description: tall pines rising above the village compound

motifs.name: lotus_pond_surface
motifs.description: lotus pond surface with scattered lily pads and light water wash

motifs.name: waterside_pavilions
motifs.description: waterside pavilions and buildings along the lotus pond edge

motifs.name: stone_arch_bridge
motifs.description: stone arched bridge over water with shrubs and masonry blocks

motifs.name: foreground_shoreline_bank
motifs.description: foreground sloping shoreline bank with rocks, shrubs, and small trees

motifs.name: bamboo_grove_and_willows
motifs.description: right-side bamboo grove and willow trees by the water

composition.name: summer_landscape_recombined
composition.theme: a new summer Chinese landscape with a lotus pond, village pavilions, distant mountain mist, bamboo, willows, a stone bridge, and a contemplative scholar near the water
composition.layout: Use distant mountains high in the background, the village nested in the middle ground, lotus water through the lower center, the stone bridge in the lower right, and a scholar on the foreground shoreline.
composition.source_style: Fine-line Chinese landscape painting with pale green and blue washes, silk or xuan paper tone, delicate architecture, misty mountain transitions, and detailed botanical brushwork.
